text:
mira: Quick design review — the compact docs panel we put in the top-right: we've got three different labels across the console: 'Docs panel', 'Help drawer', and 'Guides'. We should converge. Thoughts?
kai: Oof. I'd prefer 'In-product docs' (consistent with research + less marketing-y). Also: when a user clicks a glossary term in the panel, are we doing a deep link into the docs site or showing the inline mini-modal? Current prototype opens a new tab.
jess: Accessibility point: the panel currently traps focus but doesn't restore it to the invoking control on close. That breaks keyboard flow. Also tooltip for external-link icon lacks visible text for screen readers.
nina: From a UX perspective, inline mini-modal is better for short definitions. But for longer guides we should surface a 'Full guide' link that opens in a new tab. We should mark external links visually and via aria (e.g., "opens in a new tab").
rahul: Docs infra note: not all docs pages expose stable anchor IDs. If we commit to inline anchors, we need to add canonical anchor IDs and a fallback strategy. Our linker service can return either `anchor://page#id` or `url://docs/page` depending on availability.
docs-bot: Anchor crawler report: 7 pages missing stable anchors under /docs/serve and /docs/optimization. Recommend adding `id` attributes and documenting anchor conventions in docs repo.
mira: microcopy proposal:
- canonical name: "In-product docs"
- CTA copy: "Learn more" (for full pages) / "Definition" (for inline hits)
- small helper tooltip copy: "Opens full guide (new tab)"

jess: Agree on naming. Will file a PR to fix focus restore + add visually hidden labels for the external link icon. Also will raise contrast of link color to meet AA.
kai: I can change the panel routing: prefer this behavior chain: click glossary -> if short anchor available then show inline mini-modal (no nav); otherwise open full page in new tab. Emit analytics: `docs_panel_open`, `docs_inline_preview`, `docs_external_open`.
rahul: I'll coordinate with docs infra to add canonical anchors. ETA: 2 sprints for the bulk; we can patch the most used pages (top 10) this sprint.
nina: small UX ask: add a breadcrumb at top of the panel showing "Docs > [page name]" so users understand context when viewing inline content. Also add a back button if they navigated within the panel.
mira: good. Action list: jess -> a11y fixes + PR for focus restoration; kai -> routing + analytics; rahul -> anchor rollout plan (top10 this sprint); nina -> update figma (https://figma.com/file/efgh5678) with breadcrumbs + back behavior; mira -> copy sweep and publish microcopy guidelines to /playbooks/docs-ui. Target: small patch end of sprint, full rollout after anchor fixes. :white_check_mark:
docs-bot: Reminder: add `rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"` for all links opening new tabs for security.
rahul: noted. I'll also add a unit test in linker-service to ensure fallback to full URL when anchor missing.
mira: Thanks all — let's sign off in design channel once PRs are up.
